target_customer: Private equity firms running commercial due diligence and post-close value creation
problem: Buyout firms need to understand a target's customers, pricing and operations without seller cooperation. Operand sells AI agents and services that analyze public traces to answer this. Earlier positioning was AI consulting for consumer retail and brands (pricing and promotions).
business_model: AI-enabled services and software sold to PE funds
product_category: AI due diligence for private equity

founders.name: Ram Gorthi
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no bio. A November 2026 report cites him as CEO.

founders.name: Akhil Iyengar
education: Cornell University, computer science and economics (dropped out)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents that gather and reconcile public web signals into diligence findings need robust data pipelines but rest on existing LLM and scraping tools.

defensibility.rationale: Services-heavy offering with relationship-driven sales to PE funds; model and data tools are broadly available, so differentiation depends on execution and accumulated playbooks.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI diligence tools such as DiligentIQ (Series A of $12M in February 2025 per Business Wire) targeted PE, but at the time of the W25 batch Operand was positioned as AI consulting for consumer brands, so direct overlap was limited.

market_need_then: PE firms spend heavily on commercial diligence from consultancies. The founders first pitched replacing parts of management consulting with AI, then focused on PE.

branding.domain_note: Uses operand.com (company site); acquisition history not found.

brand_strength.rationale: Short technical word shared with several unrelated companies (a Dutch diligence tool, another Operand Inc.); no brand press found.

pivots.from: AI-enabled consulting for consumer retail and brands (pricing and promotions)
pivots.to: AI due diligence and value creation for private equity
pivots.why: Not stated in sources; YC page and November 2026 coverage show the PE focus. Exact date not given.

outcome_analysis: Operand moved from AI consulting for consumer brands to AI due diligence for private equity and raised a reported $31M across seed and Series A in November 2026 at a reported $220M valuation, led by Khosla Ventures. The jump from a $3.1M seed in 2025 suggests the PE focus found demand. The round is recent, so durability against AI diligence rivals is unproven.
notes: The 2026 round is described by outlets as $31M across seed and Series A, so stage is set to other. The CEO's LinkedIn post (quoted by a secondary source) said $30M at a $220M valuation led by Khosla with Keith Rabois joining the board; valuation is from secondary reports. The 2025 seed of $3.1M (May 2025, Soma Capital lead) is from Seedtable and Signalbase only, so treat as aggregator figure; it may overlap with the 2026 total. A Caplight banner mentioning a $16M Series A is unrelated. Competitor list left empty: no dated source found for competitors of Operand's consumer retail consulting positioning at the batch. Founder prior employers unknown from sources opened. Felicis page fetch was rate limited.
